Hi Aisha,

Quick note from procurement — we tried to accept the SIG export you dropped into our Whistic portal but the upload failed with a manifest mismatch. Ticket attached (I also looped in procurement). Error message shown in portal: "Manifest checksum mismatch: listed file redwood_sig_evidence_flattened.pdf not found or checksum different."

Can your team retry the upload and include a CSV manifest with checksums? Our security ops also prefers PDFs flattened (no annotations) and a per-document source path to speed verification.

We’re on a tight renewal timeline; if we can get a verified package by the end of this week it will keep our renewal on schedule.

Thanks,
Liam

- Regenerate the SIG export with flattened PDFs (no forms/annotations) and produce SHA256 checksums for each file.
- Produce a CSV manifest with columns: filename, sha256, file_size_bytes, source_path, created_utc.
- Re-run the Whistic preflight locally against their error sample (attached screenshot).
- If upload fails again, push incremental artifacts to our S3 staging path and share presigned links to the Acme procurement team.

Aisha — on it. Quick note on implementation: I’ll run the export through our existing manifester (adds sha256 & file sizes). I spotted two things to confirm:

1) Filename normalization: Acme’s portal is case-sensitive. We should standardize names to lower_snake_case to avoid mismatches.
2) Evidence pagination: some of our internal scanned PDFs (policy docs) currently have live bookmarks which cause non-deterministic bytes when flattened — I’ll run a deterministic flatten + OCR pass to keep content searchable.

Plan:
- Generate CSV manifest (sha256, size, source path) and attach to package.
- Generate an overall package checksum (sha256) for the ZIP.
- Upload to S3 staging: s3://redwood-evidence/procurement/2026-11-30/ and share presigned links to Acme.

If Monica hits portal errors, we’ll provide the presigned links for procurement to ingest.

I'll attach the manifest once ready. ETA 2:30pm PST.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
